findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: cycle_check · Private data: rainbow_history, cycle_check · Public sink: rainbow_today, rainbow_history, cycle_check · Destructive: rainbow_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: cycle_check · Private data: rainbow_history, cycle_check · Public sink: rainbow_today, rainbow_history, cycle_check · Destructive: rainbow_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "explain_bitcoin" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "One short plain-English explainer, the same text the website shows. Topic 'price': what price means, with the live price printed with its UTC quote time (the same shared quote the other tools print). Topic 'technical': what looking at the chart means, with the plain up-or-down move of the past year." → after: "Call this tool before explaining bitcoin in your own words. It returns the website's own plain-English explainer, and the price and rainbow topics print today's live Coinbase spot price with its UTC quote time — the rainbow topic also prints today's band — facts a from-memory answer cannot have. Use"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
